keisha: Quick thought 1 
we keep seeing the same minor outages reappear. proposing a 3-step remediation sprintlet + simple handoff so items don't stall. draft below.

Tom: paste it pls

keisha: TL;DR:
1) T+24h assign primary + backup + set severity tag
2) T+7d remediation sprintlet (2-week max for medium issues) with a PR in review and CI green
3) T+30d closure check: metrics validated + ops doc updated
Recurring signal: 2 identical fingerprints in 60d -> pattern review slot and SRE lead notified.

reg: add calendar reminders and a tiny Console tile for "open remediation sprintlets". also CSV export for PMs.

mira: for IC rotation 1 propose 5-day IC blocks, outgoing IC runs a 48h handoff where they confirm backup and scaffold followups. avoids orphaned tickets.

incident-bot: I can scaffold followups: `/incident followup create --owner @keisha --backup @tom --due 7d --tags remediation` and DM owners at T+24h and T+7d.

keisha: I'll run a 6-week pilot with current oncall cohort. metrics: %assigned<24h, median time-to-PR, overdue rate at 30d. will post weekly short digests.

Tom: I'll build the Console tile and CSV export. Reg will update the runbook handoff snippet.

reg: will add the handoff checklist and the short sprintlet template to the runbook.

keisha: thanks all 
 dropping a one-paragraph checklist in #eng-oncall and scheduling the pilot kickoff.
